subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The club later explained that the vegetables would be used in a cooking class.”?
options: Students understood that drills were not games, but they were also not only rules.
Once students understood the reason, they cared more.
Students used it again, but now they understood why it mattered.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「At first, few students cared.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

本文可直接核對「The club later explained that the vegetables would be used in a cooking class. Once students understood the reason, they cared more.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The club later explained that the vegetables would be used in a cooking class. Once students understood the reason, they cared more.」，答案為「Once students understood the reason, they cared more.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Once students understood the reason, they cared more.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
